name: intraday-equities-hstar-cv-clean2022
notes: Contamination-free H* pass 1. Three changes from the post-COVID run. (1) JPM/XOM instead of AAPL/JPM: a full-tape sweep of 8.9M bars found exactly two corrupt values in ten years, the AAPL 2020-08-31 and WMT 2024-02-26 splits, and neither JPM nor XOM has ever split in range, so no fold carries an unadjusted corporate action. (2) Training is floored at 2022-01-01: first validation is 2024-01-06, which places fold 1 train_start exactly on 2022-01-01, and every later fold slides forward from there. (3) The inner HPO is widened and now selects on rank IC rather than MSPE. At this signal-to-noise, MSPE selection is biased toward underfitting because a constant forecast is its optimum; IC cannot be won by a collapsed forecast. Cost of the 2022 floor is fold count: 11 folds against 20.

universe.notes: lead_start is the training label. One tree, five H's. Short HPO lives on the scan node, not universe.scan.

alpaca.notes: Split-adjusted historical SIP tape (source alpaca-sip-split, ADR-0063): AAPL's 2020 4-for-1, WMT's 2024 3-for-1 and the XLE/XLK 2-for-1s of December 2025 are all removed by the vendor, so no change of unit reads as a price move. start_ms is the study's start date, 2018-01-01 (ADR-0066) - it precedes the earliest bar any fold reads by 2y4m, and it puts XLF's 2016-09-19 XLRE spin-off, the one corporate action the vendor does NOT adjust, outside the readable window. Prices here are NOT the as-traded scale and are not comparable with any number recorded before 2026-09-03. Run from the child root.

session.notes: Research uses regular-session rows; the store still keeps every vendor minute.

momentum_horizons.notes: Few minutes; sharper than the 5m scale already in the 46.
Condenses the old L=120 window into ret/rv/mom.
Few hours, still inside one RTH session.

features.notes: No raw lags. Keep the 46 (5 scales × 5 moments, calendar, SPY residual, industry) plus mom on those scales and ret/rv/mom at 3m/2h/3h/2s/1w (20 extra → 66). ret_lag_0 stays internal for the SPY residual. Action lookback stays 30.

tradable.notes: Score tradable names only. SPY already entered residuals. One tree; each name still walks its own H.

pair.notes: JPM and XOM only. Both are split-free across the whole 2016-2026 tape, so the unadjusted-split contamination cannot reach any fold. Sits after tradable so the six-symbol cohort that built the features is untouched.

scan.notes: One LightGBM over JPM and XOM. HPO is 32 draws from a 288-point grid on an inner train holdout, fold val unread, selected on Spearman rank IC. Capacity (num_leaves, n_estimators) and shrinkage (min_child_samples, reg_lambda, learning_rate, colsample) are both swept, so the search can move in either direction rather than only flattening. subsample_freq=1 is set because LightGBM ignores subsample without it, which meant row bagging had never been active. max_depth=-1 lets num_leaves govern capacity alone.

walkforward.notes: Every fold trains on a full 730-day window lying entirely inside 2022-01-01 onward. Fold 1 trains 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-31. 11 folds is what 2022+ supports at 63-day steps before the 2025-11-30 cut. go_frac is out of two names, so 0, 0.5 or 1.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Summary is {name}-walkforward-{asof}-{hash8}.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity — where metrics land is not what the run computes.
